facts.fact: APS reports that the pilot phase of PRODAP, Sénégal Numérique SA's public administration digitalisation project whose first component is the consolidation of the network and digital infrastructure, targets six communes: Mbour, Dakar-Plateau, Ngor, Rufisque, Kaffrine and Kaolack; the document does not say that the communes' offices have been connected.
facts.system: Projet de promotion de la digitalisation de l'administration publique (PRODAP)

facts.fact: The pilot phase of PRODAP was launched at Mbour on Friday 24 April 2026 by its coordinator, starting with change-management activities and focus groups in the first of six pilot communes; its components are network and digital infrastructure, digitalised public services and security.
facts.system: Projet de promotion de la digitalisation de l'administration publique (PRODAP)

facts.fact: APS states that PRODAP, piloted in six communes from 24 April 2026, is a project carried by Sénégal Numérique SA (SENUM), the state's digital company; its financing is not stated.
facts.system: Projet de promotion de la digitalisation de l'administration publique (PRODAP)

systems.system: Projet de promotion de la digitalisation de l'administration publique (PRODAP)
systems.tiers: pilot phase in six communes: Mbour, Dakar-Plateau, Ngor, Rufisque, Kaffrine and Kaolack; three components: network and digital infrastructure, digitalisation of public services with outreach and training, security of the digital service offer
Mbour's mayor says PRODAP will identify existing platforms, upgrade them and centralise them with Sénégal Numérique's arrangement; not described

note: The class is read from the project's first component, network and digital infrastructure; the document itself never says a commune's office is or will be connected, and the parent may prefer to hold PRODAP as unclassified.
